about: Event nights: at nightfall there is a `chance` that the night is one of these (picked evenly), never on a hound night. Weather is forced for the night (plugin|localId of a WTHR) and the HUD tints the screen (tint RRGGBBAA). spawnMult scales how many walk at once and how fast they climb out; speedMult their speed; pointsMult every kill's points; championWeight multiplies the Iron Reaper / Necromancer weights; dropMult the power-up drop chance; boss: the night's boss rises 20 s in.
